brief: Keeps weighted subject-relation-object triples in the engine, such as alice knows bob with weight 0.5, and reads them back by position.
detail: The store is held by the engine and shared by every stzRelation object of the process, so call Clear() first for a fresh one. Positions count from 0 in the order of adding, and Remove leaves a hole instead of shifting the others. There is no lookup by subject: read the triples by position.
receiver:
o1 = new stzRelation()
o1.Clear()
o1.Add("alice", "knows", "bob", 0.5)
o1.AddSimple("bob", "knows", "carol")
